inspection_method: Opened all four generated PNGs with the image-viewing tool and checked titles, axes, labels, counts, captions and boundaries. Also opened the local Green 2019 PDF-page-15 image and compared its Table 1 cells with the entered constants.

figures.name: historical-map-checks
figures.finding: Counts and percentages are legible; selected-sample and all-period scope are visible.

figures.name: ganweriwala-area-definitions
figures.finding: Area values and different boundary definitions are legible; no statistical interval is drawn.

figures.name: observation-chain
figures.finding: All six stages and both constructed count examples are legible; synthetic status is visible.

figures.name: synthetic-find-yield
figures.finding: Scenario inputs, all three yields, logarithmic axis and synthetic status are legible.

table_normalization: Green Table 1 prints 0 (0) for the untested size-1 combined-feature cell. The analysis normalizes that displayed percentage to null because a zero-denominator proportion is undefined, while preserving tested=0 and positives=0.
source_image_handling: The downloaded page image is a local-only source witness and is not copied into the figures.
